dedupe_keys.name: china industrial environmental database 1998 2015 cod so2 nh3 n and nox by region and industrial sector

description: This database gives four industrial pollutants, chemical oxygen demand (COD), sulphur dioxide (SO2), ammonia nitrogen (NH3-N) and nitrogen oxides (NOx), for China's 31 provincial regions and 39 industrial sectors from 1998 to 2015. The figshare record was published on 4 April 2022 by Haoqi Qian, Feizhou Ren, Yanran Gong, Rong Ma, Wendong Wei and Libo Wu as one downloadable Excel file of about 2.0 MB, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is mainland China by province and sector. Caveats: it ends in 2015, the method for filling gaps between official statistics is described in the related paper, which was not read, and the name is close to the separate CEMS-based Chinese Industrial Emissions Database (CIED) for 2015 to 2018. For simulation it gives a long panel of pollution by sector and region, to link industrial output changes after disruptions to air and water pollution loads. Related catalogue records include the CIED Chinese Industrial Emissions Database and the China cement plant emissions from monitoring data.
